metadata_evidence.locator: v2 license, file list and MD5s
metadata_evidence.supports: CC-BY-4.0; exact bytes of PlotData, PlotsAbiotic and analysis script.
Inventory tree definition: free-standing woody individuals with DBH at least 10 cm; 2,046 plots retained; establishment dates differ from measurement dates.
D is trees per hectare; fa.plots is Fisher alpha; supplied richness summaries used directly.
Unique PlotCode values; 18 columns; establishment dates 1934-2021; Latin-1/Windows-1252 decode identically without replacement characters.

decisions: Transcode decoded strings to UTF-8 without changing field names, values, row order or citations. Retain all original bytes as a linked asset. Do not use establishment years as observation timestamps.
limitations: Coordinate datum is not documented in the inspected sources; this delivery is a table without inferred map geometry.
The paper reports establishment through 2020, while three supplied records have year_est=2021.
encoding_basis: ISO-8859-1; no bytes in the 0x80-0x9f range, so Windows-1252 yields identical text.
unresolved_field_definitions: ColD and some ancillary source codes are not fully defined in the delivered table; preserve them without reinterpretation.

establishment_year_exceptions.interpretation: These three establishment-year records extend beyond the paper's stated 2020 endpoint; establishment dates are not measurement dates.
